Company overview
The team behind Atomic.

Abstract Machines is a Paris-based applied AI company building intelligent software and the infrastructure behind it. Its work combines application development, open-source engineering and research across connected systems, identity and confidential computing. Atomic is its AI app builder; Atom is the open-source backend providing identity, permissions and application data.
Company: Abstract Machines
Location: Paris, France
Founded: 2023
Founder: Drasko Draskovic
Focus: Applied AI, open-source software and systems engineering
From infrastructure to applications
Abstract Machines’ engineering background includes connected systems, identity and access management, and cloud and edge software. Atomic brings that experience to people who want to build useful applications from a description of their business needs.
Three names, different roles
Atomic: The AI app builder: conversation, visual editing, previews, source and publication.
Atom: The open-source backend for identities, permissions and application data.
Abstract Machines: The company developing Atomic and Atom, alongside its wider software and research portfolio.
Engineering and research
The company develops open-source infrastructure including Magistrala, its IoT platform, and contributes to European research in orchestration, confidential computing and security. Atomic is a product of Abstract Machines, not the name of a separate company in this kit.
Drasko Draskovic · Founder & CEO
